events.title: Zwingli Falls at the Battle of Kappel
events.description: Huldrych Zwingli, the leading figure of the Swiss Reformation in Zürich, was killed in battle when Catholic cantons attacked Zürich's forces. The fighting followed a dispute over a food blockade.
events.significance: His death halted the spread of the Zwinglian Reformation in Switzerland. It helped fix the religious divide between Protestant and Catholic regions of the Swiss Confederation.

events.title: Eleanor Roosevelt Is Born
events.description: Anna Eleanor Roosevelt was born in New York City. She became First Lady of the United States and one of the most influential public figures of the 20th century.
events.significance: She redefined the role of First Lady and later helped draft the Universal Declaration of Human Rights as a U.S. delegate to the United Nations.

events.title: Second Vatican Council Opens
events.description: Pope John XXIII opened the Second Vatican Council in St. Peter's Basilica. Thousands of bishops from around the world gathered in Rome.
events.significance: The council reshaped Catholic worship and the Church's relations with other faiths and the modern world. Among other changes, Mass could now be celebrated in local languages instead of Latin.

events.title: Apollo 7 Launches
events.description: NASA launched Apollo 7, the first crewed flight of the Apollo program. Its crew orbited Earth for nearly eleven days to test the command and service module.
events.significance: The mission cleared the way for Apollo 8 to orbit the Moon two months later. That put the U.S. on track to reach the Moon by the end of the decade.
